description: Multi-turn follow-up replay family for conversation-context behaviour on the real /von/generate path. Each case runs several turns in ONE chat session and checks, per turn, that prior-turn referents remain usable while prior-turn obligations and concepts do not leak into new intents. Motivated by JVNAUTOSCI-2563 (prior-turn expected-outcome obligations leaking into follow-up intents), JVNAUTOSCI-2564 (answer grounded to a prior-session concept instead of the target verified this turn), and the JVNAUTOSCI-2553 degraded-success ingestion class. Run with scripts/run_live_multi_turn_followup_replay.py under the JVNAUTOSCI-1894 replay-and-telemetry method (expectation-first bar, real path, telemetry capture, honest per-turn verdicts).

turn_roles.task: An initial task turn that establishes referents and (implicitly) an operation-shaped expected-outcome contract.
turn_roles.bare_followup: A narrow lookup/existence question about the SAME entity as the task turn. Prior referents may be reused; prior operation obligations must NOT be inherited (JVNAUTOSCI-2563).
turn_roles.different_target_followup: A question about a DIFFERENT target than the task turn. The answer's concrete concepts must ground to the newly asked-about target, never silently substitute the earlier one (JVNAUTOSCI-2564).
turn_roles.explicit_continuation: An explicit continue/verify/finish request for the earlier operation. Prior obligations MAY legitimately carry forward; the answer must address the earlier operation's target.
turn_roles.multi_target: A question about the current target AND earlier ones together. The answer must address each target distinctly and must not collapse to a single concept (JVNAUTOSCI-2564 anti-over-constraint guardrail).

expectation_keys.assessment_scope: outcome separates route/action diagnostics from outcome checks; workflow_integration (legacy default) includes them in the verdict.
expectation_keys.requires_manual_review: Reason canonical outcome review is needed. The runner reports inconclusive until reviewed separately; never infer correctness from keyword checks.
expectation_keys.response_distinct_match: Regex pattern and minimum number of distinct full matches. Textual coverage only; does not prove identity or correctness.
expectation_keys.expected_workflow_id: Optional workflow concept ID expected in execution evidence; diagnostic only for outcome cases.
expectation_keys.require_completed: Background task must reach terminal status completed and a non-empty answer must be available; browser delivery remains unobserved.
expectation_keys.forbid_decisions: Turn execution record decision must not be one of these (e.g. escalation_required on a bare follow-up).
expectation_keys.require_prior_obligation_suppression: Legacy integration probe only. Requires explicit suppression or an observed obligation ledger, and no inherited unsatisfied obligations. Missing telemetry is inconclusive.
expectation_keys.forbid_unsatisfied_obligation_sources: No UNSATISFIED required-tool obligation may cite one of these sources (default probe: turn_expected_outcome_conditional_required_tools).
expectation_keys.allow_obligation_carry_forward: Explicit continuation: obligation inheritance is legitimate; no suppression requirement.
expectation_keys.response_must_mention_any: Visible answer must contain at least one of these strings (target grounding).
expectation_keys.response_must_not_mention: Visible answer must contain none of these strings (stale-referent grounding guard).
expectation_keys.response_must_mention_all_groups: For multi-target turns: for EACH group (list of alternative strings), the answer must mention at least one entry; checks textual coverage only; source-grounded review is still required.

turns.prompt: Please ingest https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15341 into Von, including the normal download/file-copy path if available, then read back the represented paper concept so I can see what was stored.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Establishes referents: the GenoTEX paper concept and its file copy. PDF acquisition failure is acceptable if the workflow reaches degraded success and the answer says so.

turns.prompt: Do you have a concept for https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15341

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Exact JVNAUTOSCI-2563 motivating shape. Prior paper/file-copy referents may be reused for a direct existence answer; the prior ingestion/read-back tool family must not become this turn's obligations.

turns.prompt: Is this paper represented? https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.22519v2

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Exact JVNAUTOSCI-2564 motivating shape. The answer's concrete concept handles must correspond to 2603.22519; the earlier GenoTEX concept/file-copy must not be presented as this turn's verified result. Mentioning GenoTEX as clearly-labelled prior context by name is acceptable; surfacing its concept IDs as the verified answer is not.

turns.prompt: Please verify the representation of the paper you ingested at the start of this conversation and confirm its stored concept is still retrievable.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Legitimate continuation: verification obligations for the earlier operation may carry; the answer must address the T1 paper, resolved through prior referents.

turns.prompt: Is 2603.22519 represented, and what about the paper we ingested earlier? Answer for each separately.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Anti-over-constraint guardrail: the answer must cover BOTH targets distinctly, proving the grounding fix does not force single-target binding.

turns.prompt: List my three most recent Gmail messages with sender, subject, and received time. Read-only: do not modify, label, or send anything.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Establishes mailbox referents (message IDs/subjects) with a read-only contract shape.

turns.prompt: Which Gmail profile did you just use for that listing?

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: A narrow status question sharing the mail topic. It must not inherit the prior turn's mail retrieval/detail tool family as fresh obligations; the profile referent from T1 may be reused directly.

turns.prompt: Show me the full details of the most recent message from that list, including its body.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Legitimate continuation: reuses the message referent from T1 and may carry per-message detail obligations (gmail_get_message grounded in a listed message ID).

turns.prompt: What is the most recently created Task in the JVNAUTOSCI Jira project? Give me its key, summary, and status.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Establishes a concrete Jira issue-key referent via read-only jira_search.

turns.prompt: Do you have a represented Vontology concept for that Jira issue?

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Narrow concept-existence question. The issue-key referent from T1 must be reusable; the prior Jira search/read tool family must not be inherited as obligations, and no Jira import/reconciliation path may activate.

turns.prompt: Fetch the full details of that issue directly from Jira, including description and assignee.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Legitimate continuation: jira_get_issue on the carried issue-key referent.

turns.prompt: Summarise both that issue and the one created immediately before it, separately.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Two distinct issue keys are necessary. Review canonical Jira sources to confirm these are the intended issue and its immediate predecessor, each summarised accurately.

turns.prompt: On Jira issue JVNAUTOSCI-2591, add the label uc05-live-validated if it is absent, without changing any other field. Then fetch that exact issue directly from Jira and report its key, status, and complete label list so the change is verified by read-back.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Authorised bounded UC-05 mutation. The turn must resolve the exact key, preserve other fields, perform at most one label update, and verify canonical Jira state after the write.

turns.prompt: Repeat that exact operation for JVNAUTOSCI-2591. Do not create a duplicate label or change another field. Fetch the issue again and report the complete label list from Jira.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Repeated UC-05 mutation must be idempotent: the same label remains present exactly once after direct Jira read-back.

turns.prompt: Create a represented note concept containing exactly this text: 'Multi-turn replay checkpoint for the follow-up family.' Then read it back so I can see the stored concept.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Establishes a freshly created concept referent through the generic representation path (create + text relation + read-back).

turns.prompt: Do you have a concept for that note?

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Deictic narrow lookup: the note referent must resolve from prior context; the prior mutation/read-back tool family must not be inherited as fresh obligations.

turns.prompt: Verify the note concept you created is still retrievable and show me its stored content.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Legitimate verification continuation: read-back obligations for the earlier mutation may carry.

turns.prompt: Create today's operational-reliability programme status digest from current JVNAUTOSCI Jira evidence, current repository evidence, and the prior represented digest. Persist it as the canonical digest work product. Include verified changes, milestones, blockers, unresolved or stale obligations, decisions needed, deadlines, and evidence gaps. Keep Jira Done, workflow completed, and capability passed distinct. Read-only outside the digest work product: do not transition, comment on, close, assign, or otherwise change Jira, GitHub, mail, or workflow instances.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Real UC-06 foreground path. The represented workflow must read current Jira/repository evidence and prior durable state, update only the stable digest concept, read it back, and avoid conflating issue, workflow, and capability states.

turns.prompt: Run that digest again against current evidence. Reuse the same represented digest work product and preserve each outstanding commitment's canonical source/task identity when its owner or due date changes. Absence from a search window does not resolve it. Tell me what changed since the prior digest and what evidence is unavailable. Keep every external system read-only.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.
expectations.notes: Repeated UC-06 execution checks stable work-product and commitment identity across owner/date changes. Inspect the canonical text and actual effects: keyword/tool matches alone cannot pass the outcome. This same-chat case does not establish cross-encounter continuity, autonomous noticing or real-role adoption.

expectations.requires_manual_review: Verify the requested outcome against canonical sources and effects; keyword checks alone do not establish correctness.

scholarly representation of the paper could not be executed
expectations.notes: The JVNAUTOSCI-2553 motivating paper. Success is metadata representation + read-back; PDF acquisition is optional enrichment. If acquisition failed, the answer must say so honestly (degraded success), never convert it into a terminal failure or surface raw support-error codes as the answer.
